contexts.text: Those who have been delighted with plundering.
Thus rapine, spoil, prey = the forcible taking away and deliverance of the good by the Lord. Illustrated.
Full of rapine () = evil from falsity, (violence inflicted by falsity. AE 355:23.)
(These inhabitants of Venus) are very much delighted with spoil, especially to eat of the spoil. AC 3346, AC 3347.
Although they live in rapine, etc.
The dissipation of falsities and evils is signified by to eat of the prey ().
The prey over which the lion roareth () = deliverance from evils from Hell. AE 601:5.
To catch the prey () = the destruction of the truth and good of the Church.
